messages:
tara-cs: Quick alert — SpectralCare hit regional throttles during a partner demo. They asked for a temporary throughput bump and IP allowlist for EU + APAC while onboarding finishes. Case 834210 opened. Need fast triage.

ben-ops: What QPS and CIDRs are they asking for? Which edges?

tara-cs: Case 834210 details: EU -> 2800 qps (today ~800), APAC -> 1100 qps (today ~380). Window 48h starting now, then auto-revoke. Egress CIDRs: 3.126.0.0/16 and 54.72.128.0/21. Prefer eu-west + apac-sg edges.

nina-net: I can push ephemeral L7 allowlist entries with TTL=172800s (48h). No peering needed for ephemeral. Will tag 'customer:spectralcare' and set auto-revoke timestamp in the case.

sam-eng: Which route/model? For the burst set max_concurrency=8, cap max_tokens=400, enable prefix caching, and pin a fallback to redwood/llama-2-13b-chat-q4 if the 70b saturates. Also recommend warming KV with demo prompts.

tara-cs: Route: sc-assistant-prod -> redwood/llama-2-70b-chat-q4. Customer ok with fallback to 13b-q4. Also requested per-region request counts during the window.

jess-ml: Quick perf note — limit per-request max_tokens to 350 for the window and enable short retry-on-5xx to reduce client-facing errors. That should keep p95 reasonable.

infra-bot: Ticket 834210-ephemeral-allowlist created by tara-cs. Assigned: nina-net. SLA: 3h.

nina-net: Applying L7 rules now. Plan: ephemeral rules TTL=172800, tag 'ephemeral:spectralcare-834210', map CIDRs to eu-west/apac-sg edge pools. Rolling apply ~2m.

ben-ops: After apply please drop a smoke curl we can give the customer. Use the chat endpoint.

nina-net: Done — rules applied. Verified 200 from test IP 3.126.45.8 hitting eu-west gateway. Auto-revoke scheduled. Curl we used:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat \
-H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
-d '{"route":"sc-assistant-prod","input":"health check","max_tokens":6}'
```

sam-eng: Ran a small synthetic pilot at 400qps: p50 88ms, p95 360ms, p99 710ms. Enabled KV warmup and prefix caching. No redispatch queueing observed. Will monitor p99 during the demo.

tara-cs: Thanks team :raised_hands: Notifying SpectralCare that the bump + allowlist are live. Renewal note: their enterprise renewal in 14 days — this demo is high impact.

ben-ops: Added Renewal Watch to case 834210 and CC'd AE/sales. Paste smoke logs to the case and capture any post-demo feedback.

tara-cs: Will update the case with logs and schedule a quick 15-min enablement run-through with their SRE. Closing loop with sales after demo.
